scope: game_runtime F3 codex right-bottom segmented pointer control zone
implemented: Runtime F3 codex mouse-left input now requires the cursor to be inside the right-bottom segmented control zone instead of advancing the codex entry from any window position
The five horizontal control-zone segments map left-to-right to previous category, next category, previous entry, next entry, and discovered-only filter toggle
Mouse right button remains a previous-entry shortcut and mouse middle button remains a discovered-only filter shortcut
The pointer-zone helper uses the Runtime meta panel width, right margin, and bottom control height to keep the clickable area aligned with the existing right-side station panel
The F3 helper text exposes the right-bottom control zone without loading generated story/codex candidate text
The Runtime surface contract now records the pointer-zone source-shape alongside keyboard, pointer shortcut, and gamepad bindings
limitations: This is a text-panel segmented pointer control zone, not a complete visual button layout.
It is covered by source-shape and unit tests, not by a real physical mouse or touchscreen manual review.
It reads accepted runtime content pack metadata and MetaProgress only; it does not load generated story/codex candidate text.
It does not replace human story review, Runtime UI review, final human acceptance, manual base UI review, Bevy smoke, or release readiness.
